font.family.description: Primary font family name used for terminal text rendering.

font.line_height.description: Line height multiplier relative to font size (<= 2.0).

decoration.border.description: Whether window decoration borders are enabled.

decoration.border_width.description: Width of the window border in pixels.

appearance.theme.description: Built-in theme name (e.g. catppuccin-mocha, tokyo-night, gruvbox-dark).

keymaps.description: User keybinding overrides and chord registrations.

leader_key.description: Leader key prefix for multi-key chords.

leader_timeout_ms.description: Timeout in milliseconds before an incomplete leader chord cancels.

hints_enabled.description: Whether interactive chord hint overlays are enabled.

workspace.show_bar.description: Whether the workspace status bar is displayed.

workspace.bar.edge.description: Edge placement of the workspace status bar ('top' or 'bottom').

mouse.focus_follows_mouse.description: Whether pane focus follows cursor movement.

mouse.focus_follows_mouse_delay_ms.description: Dwell time in milliseconds before focus follows mouse switches pane.
